about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of Makoto Hayakawa as she eases into her new role behind the counter of a small-town convenience store in this limited access demo for inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories.

Handle nightly routines, keep the store in order, and assist a late-night regular in finding just what he needs — be it a warm meal, a treat for his pet, or a familiar drink that stirs old memories.

Through highly intuitive interactive conversations, you'll have a chance to offer a kind word, a bit of advice, or simply listen — sometimes, even the smallest exchange can brighten someone's night!

The quiet challenges of working alone can feel daunting at first, but Aunt Hina is just a phone call away with helpful guidance whenever you need it.

Demo Features

  • Enjoy a highly replayable, narrative-focused gameplay;

  • Experience an introduction to Makoto’s observational journey;

  • Soak in the nostalgic atmosphere of a small-town konbini in early 1990s Japan;

  • Interact with regulars and help them find exactly what they need through intuitive, heartfelt conversations;

  • Explore the store for subtle narrative clues hidden in plain sight;

  • Call Aunt Hina for friendly advice or guidance whenever you need a hand.

Have a sneak peek at inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories with this early demo — an atmospheric, story-rich introduction to a world where the ordinary becomes meaningful, and every customer has a story to tell…

Wishlist the full game and stay tuned for more stories behind the counter!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 760 / Radeon HD 7950 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 / Radeon R9 390 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 9 GB available space

short_description: Play inKONBINI: Prologue Demo! Step into Makoto’s shoes as she begins her work behind the counter at the Honki-Ponki konbini. Meet your first customer, ease into the quiet rhythm of the small-town store, and start to uncover the stories it holds.
